logline: 장미 한 송이를 꺾은 값으로, 상인의 막내딸이 성에 홀로 남는다.
destination: 성 안쪽의 잠긴 서쪽 방 — 들어가지 말라 이른 곳
protagonist: 짙은 갈색 머리를 땋아 내린 열여덟 살 처녀
setting: 18세기 프랑스의 눈 덮인 숲과 낡은 성
anchor: a young woman of eighteen with dark brown hair in a braid, plain travelling dress
palette: snow white, forest green, warm amber, deep rose red, cold pale grey

belle.label: 막내딸
belle.desc: a young woman of eighteen, dark brown hair in a braid, plain grey travelling dress, wool cloak

merchant.label: 상인 아버지
merchant.desc: a tired man in his fifties, grey stubble, worn brown coat and riding boots, gloved hands

beast.label: 성의 주인
beast.desc: a huge shaggy figure in a torn velvet coat, broad clawed hands, heavy horned head, amber eyes

castle_hall.label: 성의 홀
castle_hall.desc: a vast cold stone hall with a long laid table, candelabra burning, tall dark doors

beats.beat: 상인이 눈 덮인 정원에서 장미를 꺾는다.
beats.visual: a tired man in a worn coat snapping a red rose from a snow-covered garden bush
beats.motion: the stem breaks in his glove, snow shakes off the bush, petals drop to the white ground

beats.beat: 성의 주인이 어둠 속에서 걸어 나온다.
beats.visual: a huge shaggy figure in a torn velvet coat stepping from dark arches toward a small man
beats.motion: he strides forward out of the arches, snow blows past him, the man staggers back

beats.visual: a young woman in a cloak mounting a horse before a snowbound cottage, her father held back
beats.motion: she swings up onto the horse, her cloak sweeps out, the father's hand falls

beats.beat: 처녀가 텅 빈 홀의 긴 상 앞에 앉는다.
beats.visual: a young woman seated alone at one end of a long laid table in a vast candlelit hall
beats.motion: candle flames lean along the table, her chair draws itself in, steam rises off the dishes

beats.visual: a huge shaggy figure seated at the far end of a long table facing a young woman
beats.motion: he lowers himself into the chair, candles gutter down the table, his coat settles

beats.beat: 처녀가 잠긴 서쪽 문 앞에 선다.
beats.visual: a young woman before a tall locked door in a dim stone corridor, one candle in her hand
beats.motion: her hand rises toward the handle, the candle flame bends, shadows swing on the stone

beats.beat: 처녀가 유리 덮개 속 장미를 들여다본다.
beats.visual: a young woman leaning over a red rose under a glass dome, few petals left on the stem
beats.motion: a petal loosens and falls inside the glass, her breath fogs it, candlelight shifts

beats.beat: 빈 홀의 긴 상에 촛불만 사위어 간다.
beats.visual: a long empty banquet table in a vast stone hall, candles burned low, chairs pushed back
beats.motion: the last candles sink and gutter, wax runs down, cold light spreads from the windows

withheld: 장미의 마지막 꽃잎이 지면 벌어지는 일과, 성 주인의 본디 모습
